title_en: 1+1 apartment for sale - Rruga 5 Maji, part of the Emerald complex in Tirana! €180,000
description_en: 📍 EMERALD Complex - behind the Madrasa Market 💰 Price: €180,000 Century 21 offers for sale a modern 1+1 apartment, just completed, part of the EMERALD residential complex, in one of the most accessible and developed areas of Tirana. 📐 Gross area: 82.2 m² 📐 Net area: 72 m² Interior layout: Living room with kitchen 1 bedroom 1 bathroom Balcony Features: 8th floor (not the last) Orientation South, natural lighting throughout the day New construction, high quality Well-managed building The property is ideal for both residence and investment, thanks to the position and the high demand of the area.
